currentParagraphText: Artemis just smiled and shook her head. “Seeing is understanding, as the saying goes. When one becomes able to perceive concepts, one also becomes able to analyze and try to understand them. Form one’s own concept from another’s. Someone like the Void Mechanist does this through study and a high level of intellect that can’t truly be copied. However, for people like you and I, that isn’t gonna happen.”
